dependencyNotes.gsap: Free in full since Webflow acquired GSAP in 2025 — all plugins, no Club tier, no licence key. ScrollTrigger and CustomEase ship inside this same package; see node_modules/gsap/ScrollTrigger.js. Do not re-litigate this.
dependencyNotes.lenis: Smooth scroll. Loaded only after a prefers-reduced-motion check — see src/layouts/Base.astro.
dependencyNotes.lucide-static: Raw SVG source only. Imported with ?raw and inlined at build time by src/components/ui/Icon.astro; no runtime ships to the client.
